name: bjjgraph
description: BJJ knowledge graph and state machine

scripts.dev:neural: node neural/build/build.mjs && python3 scripts/regenerate_neural_data.py && cp -r source/quartz/static/neural/. source/public/static/neural/ && mkdir -p source/public/static/neural/app && cp neural/dist/neural.js neural/dist/neural.css source/public/static/neural/app/ && echo 'neural refreshed (~seconds) — reload the browser'
scripts.dev:neural:app: node neural/build/build.mjs && cp neural/dist/neural.js neural/dist/neural.css source/public/static/neural/app/ && echo 'app bundle refreshed (<1s) — reload the browser'
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.regenerate:graph: npm run regenerate:graph-base && npm run regenerate:graph-layout && npm run regenerate:ordinals && npm run regenerate:graph-strength
scripts.regenerate:neural: node neural/build/build.mjs && python3 scripts/regenerate_neural_data.py && mkdir -p source/quartz/static/neural/app && cp neural/dist/* source/quartz/static/neural/app/
scripts.regenerate: npm run regenerate:issues && npm run regenerate:json && npm run regenerate:explode && npm run migrate:ruleset && npm run validate:graph && npm run regenerate:md && npm run regenerate:hubs && npm run regenerate:votes && npm run regenerate:graph && npm run regenerate:explorer
scripts.build: cd source && npx quartz build --concurrency 4 -d ../content && python3 ../scripts/regenerate_redirects.py && python3 ../scripts/regenerate_headers.py && python3 ../scripts/check_headers_cache.py && python3 ../scripts/regenerate_llms_txt.py && cd .. && npm run build:forward && npm run build:share-shell && npm run validate:payload
scripts.regenerate:build: npm run regenerate && npm run build
